title: Differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells to brain microvascular endothelial cell-like cells suitable to study immune cell interactions
protocol: Add 30 mL cold DMEM/F-12 to a 50 mL tube.
Remove 1 mL of DMEM/F-12 using a micropipette.
Pipet up and down with 1 mL of DMEM/F-12 to thaw and dissolve a Matrigel aliquot containing 2.5 mg Matrigel.
Add the thawed Matrigel to the 50 mL tube containing 29 mL cold DMEM/F-12.
Add 1 mL of the resulting Matrigel solution to each well of the 6-well plates.
Agitate each plate to ensure complete coverage of the bottom with Matrigel solution.
Place the plates in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 for at least 1 hour.
Prepare a 15 mL centrifuge tube containing 4 mL mTeSR1 medium at 20°C–25°C.
Thaw 1 vial of cryopreserved hESCs/hiPSCs by rapidly rubbing the tube between your hands or swirling it in a 37°C water bath until there is only a small piece of ice remaining.
Slowly add 500 μL of mTeSR1 medium to the cryotube and gently pipet up and down once to completely thaw hPSCs.
Transfer hPSCs slowly to the centrifuge tube containing mTeSR1 medium.
Centrifuge hPSCs at 200 g, 5 min, at 20°C–25°C.
While hPSCs are centrifuging, label a Matrigel-coated plate with the name of the cell line, passage number, and passage date.
Remove the supernatant from cells.
Resuspend pellet in 2 mL of mTeSR1 medium + 10 μM ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 (add stock solution at 1:1000).
Aspirate Matrigel coating solution from the 6-well plate.
Seed hPSCs suspension onto Matrigel-coated wells.
Transfer 6-well plate into incubator (37°C, 5% CO2).
Gently move the plate back and forth and from side to side on the shelf inside the incubator.
Avoid circular motions to prevent cells from pooling in the center of the well.
One day later, remove ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 by replacing medium with 2 mL of mTeSR1 medium.
Change mTeSR1 medium every day to reduce probability of spontaneous differentiation.
Aspirate medium from one well of hPSCs.
Wash hPSCs with 1 mL Versene.
Subsequently aspirate Versene from the well.
Add 1 mL of Versene to the well of hPSCs.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 in the incubator for 4-7 min.
Label a new Matrigel-coated plate with the name of the cell line, passage number, passage date, and split ratio.
Aspirate Matrigel coating solution from 3 wells.
Add 1 mL of mTeSR1 medium per well of the 6-well plate.
Prepare a 15 mL centrifuge tube containing 2 mL of mTeSR1 medium at 20°C–25 °C.
Observe the detachment process of hPSCs under the microscope.
Once hPSCs start to detach, remove Versene and dissociate hPSCs by vigorously pipetting 2 mL of mTeSR1 medium.
If hPSCs do not detach well, gently scrape hPSCs using the tip of a 5 mL pipet and pipette mTeSR1 over the hPSCs again.
Collect 1 mL of the hPSCs suspension in mTeSR1 medium.
Transfer the collected suspension to a 15 mL conical tube containing 2 mL of mTeSR1 medium.
Distribute 1 mL of the hPSC suspension into each well of a prepared plate (for a total volume of 2 mL per well).
Passage hPSCs at a ratio of 1:6.
Transfer the 6-well plate to an incubator set at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Gently move the plate back and forth and from side to side on the shelf inside the incubator.
Avoid circular motions during plate movement to prevent cells from pooling in the center of the well.
Place the plate onto the incubator shelf first before moving it within the incubator.
If using a newly thawed hPSC line, maintain hPSCs in culture and passage at least once more before initiating EPC differentiation.
Passage hPSCs when they reach 80% confluency in 4-7 days.
Increase split ratio if passage takes longer than 7 days.
Eliminate spontaneously differentiated cells by picking undifferentiated hPSC colonies using a sterile pipette tip or treating cultures with Versene for 2-3 minutes.
Prepare Matrigel-coated 12-well plates using the method in step 1, except use 0.5 mL of Matrigel solution per well of each 12-well plate.
Incubate at least 1 h at 37°C.
Aspirate mTeSR1 medium from one well of hPSCs in a 6-well plate.
Add 1 mL Accutase to the well and incubate at 37°C until hPSCs completely detach.
Using a micropipette, collect detached hPSCs and pipette gently over surface 2–3 times.
Transfer collected hPSCs into a 15 mL centrifuge tube containing 4 mL of mTeSR1 medium.
Resuspend the cells well in the medium.
Take 10 μL of the hPSC suspension and pipette into a Neubauer Chamber for cell counting.
Centrifuge hPSCs at 200 g for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Count hPSCs on the Neubauer Chamber to determine appropriate volume per well.
Calculate the volume of cells needed for each well based on the desired seeding density (range: 75-400 ×10³ hPSCs/well).
Seed at least 6 wells in a 12-well plate for EPC differentiation.
After centrifuging, remove supernatant and resuspend pellet in 1 mL of mTeSR1 medium.
Add appropriate volume of hPSC suspension to each well containing 1 mL of mTeSR1 + 10 μM ROCK inhibitor Y-27632.
Transfer the 6-well plate into the incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Gently move the plate back and forth and from side to side on the incubator shelf to evenly distribute the cells.
Remove mTeSR1 + ROCK inhibitor approximately 24 hours later (Day -2) and replace with 2 mL of mTeSR1 medium per well.
Replace the medium again with 2 mL of mTeSR1 medium per well approximately 24 hours after the previous step (Day -1).
Optimize the seeding density of hPSCs at Day -3 for each hPSC line and passage.
Supplement LaSR basal medium with 8 μM CHIR99021.
Warm the supplemented medium to 20°C–25°C.
Remove mTeSR1 from wells and add 2 mL of supplemented LaSR basal medium.
Aspirate the medium on Day 1 and replace with 2 mL of supplemented LaSR basal medium.
Aspirate the medium on Day 2, 3, and 4 and replace with 2 mL of prewarmed LaSR basal medium without CHIR99021.
Aspirate the medium from wells at Day 5.
Add 1 mL Accutase to each well and incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 6-8 minutes.
Pipette 5-10 times with a micropipette to obtain a single-cell suspension.
Filter the cell suspensions through a 40 μm Falcon cell strainer into a 50 mL Centrifuge tube containing 12 mL DMEM/F-12-10 medium.
Fill up the DMEM/F-12-10 medium in the tube to 50 mL to stop the Accutase reaction and resuspend cells.
Take 10 μL of cell suspension and place onto a Neubauer Chamber for counting.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 g for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate the supernatant after centrifugation.
Add 15 mL DMEM/F-12-10 medium to resuspend the pellet in a fresh tube.
Transfer the resulting cell suspension into a fresh 15 mL centrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge the cells again at 200 g for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate the supernatant from cell pellets.
Resuspend the cell pellets at a concentration of 1 × 10^7 cells per 100 μL Flow Buffer-1.
Add 1:100 FcR blocking reagent and incubate for 5 min.
Add 1:200 FITC-conjugated CD31 antibody and incubate in the dark at 20°C–25°C for 30 min.
Add 10 mL FlowBuffer-1 after incubation.
Take a 10 μL sample to perform flow cytometry analysis.
Centrifuge the remaining cell suspension at 200 g for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet at a concentration of 1 × 10^7 cells per 100 μL Flow Buffer-1.
Add EasySep FITC Selection Cocktail at 5 μL per 100 μL antibody labeled cell suspension.
Incubate at 20°C–25°C for 15 min.
Vortex Magnetic Nanoparticles.
Add Magnetic Nanoparticles at 5 μL per 100 μL cell suspension.
Resuspend the cells by pipetting and incubate at 20°C–25°C for 10 min.
Bring the cell suspension to a total volume of 2.5 mL Flow Buffer-1.
Transfer the cell suspension into a 5 mL round-bottom flow cytometry tube.
Place the flow cytometry tube (without cap) into the magnet and incubate for 5 min.
Invert the magnet and flow tube in one continuous motion, pouring off the supernatant fraction containing FITC-CD31 antibody unlabeled cells.
Allow the supernatant to drop off by leaving the magnet and tube inverted for 2–3 s.
Carefully aspirate the remaining drop at the edge of the tube using a Pasteur pipet attached to a vacuum pump.
Return the tube containing the CD31+ cells to an upright position.
Remove the flow cytometry tube containing CD31+ cells from the magnet.
Add 2.5 mL FlowBuffer-1 to the tube and resuspend the cell suspension by gently pipetting up and down 2–3 times.
Place the flow tube back into the magnet and incubate for 5 min.
Repeat steps q-s three times and then step q once more (for a total of 4 washes).
Remove the flow cytometry tube from the magnet after washing.
Resuspend purified CD31+ cells in an appropriate amount of desired medium.
Take a 10 μL sample of cell suspension for counting.
Take an additional 10 μL sample of cell suspension for flow cytometry analysis.
Use a flow cytometer to assess the percentage of CD31+ cells in the pre-MACS samples.
Use a flow cytometer to assess the percentage of CD31+ cells in the post-MACS samples.
Prepare collagen IV-coated plates for EECM-BMEC-like cell culture.
Dilute 300 μL of collagen IV (1 mg/mL) with 30 mL sterile water.
Add 1 mL of the diluted collagen solution to each well of a 6-well plate.
Incubate plates with collagen IV at 37°C for at least 30 minutes.
Aspirate collagen IV coating solution from the 6-well plate.
Add 1–2 × 10^5 purified CD31+ EPCs in 2 mL hECSR supplemented with 5 μM ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 per well of the 6-well plate.
Transfer the 6-well plate into the incubator (37°C, 5% CO2).
Gently move the plate back and forth and from side to side on the incubator shelf to evenly distribute the cells.
Approximately 24 hours later, remove ROCK inhibitor by aspirating hECSR medium.
Replace with 2 mL fresh hECSR medium pre-warmed to 20°C–25°C.
Change hECSR medium every second day until CD31+ cells reach 100% confluency.
Once CD31+ cells reach 100% confluency, perform selective passaging as described below.
Aspirate hECSR medium from 6-well plate containing CD31+ cells.
Add 1 ml of Accutase to each well of the 6-well plate.
Monitor cell morphology under a microscope until ECs appear round and non-ECs remain attached.
Tap the edge of the 6-well plate to detach ECs.
Collect detached ECs by avoiding resuspension of non-ECs.
Transfer collected ECs to a 15 mL centrifuge tube containing 4 mL of hESFM.
Add 2 mL hECSR medium to each well with remaining attached non-ECs to obtain SMLCs.
Return the plate to the incubator.
Resuspend the EC suspension in the 15 mL tube.
Collect 10 μL of the EC suspension for counting.
Centrifuge ECs at 200 g, 5 min, at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 2 mL of hECSR medium per 1–2 × 10^5 ECs.
Aspirate collagen IV coating solution from a new 6-well plate.
Add 2 mL of EC suspension per well to the plate.
Transfer the 6-well plate into the incubator (37°C, 5% CO2).
Gently move the plate back and forth and side to side on the incubator shelf to evenly distribute cells.
Change hECSR medium every second day until ECs reach 100% confluency.
Resuspend EPCs in freezing medium at a concentration of 1–2 × 10^6 cells per mL immediately after the last MACS wash.
Transfer 1 mL of EPCs suspension to each cryotube.
Transfer cryotubes to a controlled-rate freezing device and immediately place at -80°C.
Store cryotubes in liquid nitrogen tank after 24 to 48 hours for long-term storage.
Aspirate hECSR medium from 6-well plate containing EECM-BMEC-like cells or SMLCs.
Add 1 mL of Accutase per well and incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 until cell detachment.
Collect detached cells in a 15 mL centrifuge tube with hESFM or DMEM/F-12-10 medium.
Resuspend EECM-BMEC-like cells or SMLCs suspension and collect 10 μL for counting.
Centrifuge EECM-BMEC-like cells or SMLCs at 200 g, 5 min, at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in freezing medium at 1-2 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Transfer 1 mL of cell suspension to each cryotube.
Place cryotubes immediately into a controlled-rate freezing device at -80°C.
Transfer cryotubes to liquid nitrogen tank after 24 to 48 hours for long-term storage.
Prepare a collagen IV-coated 6-well plate as described in step 7.
Prepare a 15 mL Centrifuge tube containing 4 mL of hESFM or DMEM/F-12-10.
Thaw a cryotube containing EPCs, EECM-BMEC-like cells, or SMLCs rapidly by rubbing the tube between your hands until only a small piece of ice remains.
Slowly add 500 μL of hESFM or DMEM/F-12-10 to the cryotube and transfer the cell suspension to the centrifuge tube, resuspending cells.
Rinse the cryotube once with 1 mL hESFM or DMEM/F-12-10 and transfer rinse solution to the centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge cells at 200 g for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Remove supernatant from the centrifuge tube and resuspend the pellet in 2 mL hECSR medium supplemented with 5 μM ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 to a cell count of 2–3 × 10^5 cells/mL.
Add 2 mL cell suspension to each well of a collagen IV-coated 6-well plate.
Transfer the 6-well plate into the incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Gently move the plate back and forth and from side to side on the shelf inside the incubator to distribute cells evenly.
Avoid circular motions to prevent cells from pooling in the center of the well.
Place the plate onto the incubator shelf first before moving it using the shelf as support.
Remove ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 by replacing the medium with hECSR medium one day later.
Prepare 200 μL of a 4:1:5 collagen IV/fibronectin/water coating solution.
Add 200 μL of the coating solution to each Transwell filter.
Incubate the coated Transwell filters in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 for at least 4 hours.
Aspirate hECSR medium from EECM-BMEC-like cells at passage 3–5.
Add 1 mL of Accutase per well to a 6-well plate containing EECM-BMEC-like cells.
Incubate the cells with Accutase at 37°C and 5% CO2 until they detach, approximately 7 minutes.
Collect detached EECM-BMEC-like cells in a 15 mL centrifuge tube containing 4 mL of hESFM or DMEM/F-12-10.
Resuspend the cell suspension well.
Take 10 μL of the cell suspension for counting.
Centrifuge EECM-BMEC-like cells at 200 g for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 500 μL hECSR medium with a cell count of 1.12 × 10^5 cells.
Aspirate the collagen IV/fibronectin/water coating solution from Transwell filters.
Add 500 μL of the EECM-BMEC-like cell suspension to each Transwell filter.
Add 1.5 mL of hECSR medium to the bottom chamber.
Transfer a 6-well plate into an incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Gently move the plate back and forth and from side to side on the incubator shelf.
Change hECSR medium every second day until day 6.
Prepare a new 12-well plate containing 1.5 mL warm hECSR medium per well at day 6.
Use forceps to carefully transfer the Transwell filters intended for permeability assay, including the blank filter, to this new 12-well plate.
In a 15 mL centrifuge tube, prepare 500 μL of 10 uM sodium fluorescein solution in hECSR medium per Transwell filter.
Remove hECSR medium from the top chamber.
Replace with 500 μL hECSR medium containing 10 μM sodium fluorescein in all samples, including blank Transwell filters.
Collect 150 μL of medium from the bottom chamber at 15, 30, 45, and 60 min.
Place collected medium into a 96-well plate (flat bottom).
Go into the bottom chamber at the side of the filter and pipette gently up and down 2–3 times with micropipette.
Replace the missing volume in the bottom chamber with 150 μL pre-warmed hECSR medium.
Collect 150 μL of medium from the top chamber at the 60-minute time point.
Transfer collected medium to a 96-well plate.
Place an additional 150 μL of hECSR medium without sodium fluorescein in the 96-well plate for background subtraction.
Read fluorescence intensity using a fluorescent plate reader (485 nm excitation/530 nm emission).
Remove background signal and account for signal loss from sampling the bottom chamber.
Correct the 15-minute sample signal to 1000 RFU after removing background.
Correct the 30-minute sample signal to 1500 RFU after removing background.
Calculate the corrected signal at 30 minutes as (1500 RFU + (1000 RFU × 150 μL/1500 μL)) = 1600 RFU.
Use 1600 RFU as the 30-minute sample value when calculating the 45-minute corrected signal.
Calculate the clearance volume at each time point using VB × (SB,t) / (ST,60 min), where VB is the bottom chamber volume (1500 μL).
Determine the linear slope of clearance volume versus time for each triplicate culture Transwell filter and the blank filter using linear regression.
Subtract the "resistance" of the blank Transwell filter from the "resistance" of the cell-containing Transwell filter to calculate sodium fluorescein permeability.
Fix Transwell filters with −20°C precooled methanol (150 μL top chamber/1 mL bottom chamber) for 20 s after the permeability assay.
Rehydrate and wash fixed filters.
Cut out filters using a scalpel.
Transfer filters to a 24-well plate and add 150 μl of blocking buffer for blocking and cell membrane permeabilization.
Stain filters for junctional molecules to evaluate monolayer confluency as described below.
Transfer stained filters to a glass slide.
Mount with Mowiol and coverslip.
Aspirate hECSR medium from the 6-well plate containing EECM-BMEC-like cells or SMLCs.
Add 1 mL of Accutase per well of the 6-well plate.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 in the incubator until cells detach (approximately 7 min for EECM-BMEC-like cells and 10–20 min for SMLCs).
Collect EECM-BMEC-like cells or SMLCs in a 15 mL centrifuge tube containing 4 mL of hESFM or DMEM/F-12-10 per 1 mL of Accutase.
Resuspend EECM-BMEC-like cells or SMLCs suspension well and take 10 μL of cell suspension for counting.
Centrifuge EECM-BMEC-like cells or SMLCs at 200 g, 5 min, at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend at 2.5 × 10^5 EECM-BMEC-like cells or SMLCs per mL of hECSR medium.
Aspirate the collagen IV coating solution and add 100 μL of EECM-BMEC-like cells or SMLCs suspension to each well of the 16-well chamber slide or 96-well plate (2.5 × 10^4/well).
Transfer 16-well chamber slide or 96-well plate into the incubator (37°C, 5% CO2).
Gently move the plate back and forth on the shelf to distribute cells evenly.
Move the plate from side to side on the shelf to ensure even distribution of cells.
Avoid circular motions to prevent cell pooling in the center of wells.
Place the plate onto the incubator shelf first for support during movement.
Wait 1-2 hours for EECM-BMEC-like cells or SMLCs to attach to the slide or plate.
Replace hECSR medium with 100 μL hECSR medium.
Remove nonadherent EECM-BMEC-like cells or SMLCs.
Change hECSR medium again approximately 24 hours later for feeding.
Investigate adhesion molecule expression on EECM-BMEC-like cells.
Change hECSR medium to CM derived from SMLCs in the presence or absence of 0.1 ng/mL TNF-α + 2 IU/mL IFN-γ.
Incubate with CM and/or cytokines for 16–24 hours.
Fix EECM-BMEC-like cells with 100 μL of −20°C precooled methanol for 20 s and rehydrate by washing 3 times with 100 μL of dPBS.
Block and permeabilize cell membrane with 100 μL of blocking buffer for 10 min at 20°C–25°C.
Stain EECM-BMEC-like cells with 100 μL of primary antibodies diluted in blocking buffer for 1 h at 20°C–25°C.
Dilute primary antibodies in 100 μL of hECSR medium and add to live EECM-BMEC-like cells.
Incubate EECM-BMEC-like cells with primary antibodies at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 15 min.
Fix EECM-BMEC-like cells with 100 μL of 1% (w/v) paraformaldehyde in dPBS for 10 min at 20°C–25°C.
Wash cells with dPBS and block EECM-BMEC-like cells with 100 μL of blocking buffer for 10 min at 20°C–25°C.
Fix SMLCs with 100 μL of 1% (w/v) paraformaldehyde in dPBS for 10 min at 20°C–25°C.
Wash SMLCs with 100 μL of dPBS.
Block and permeabilize SMLCs with 100 μL of blocking buffer for 10 min at 20°C–25°C.
Incubate SMLCs with 100 μL of primary antibodies diluted in blocking buffer for 1 h at 20°C–25°C.
Wash EECM-BMEC-like cells or SMLCs three times with 100 μL of dPBS.
Incubate with 100 μL of secondary antibodies diluted in blocking buffer for 1 h at 20°C–25°C.
Add DAPI at 1 μg/mL or Hoechst 33342 at 4 μM to the secondary antibody solution.
Wash EECM-BMEC-like cells or SMLCs three times with 100 μL of dPBS.
Remove plastic chamber from glass slide if using a chamber slide.
Mount with Mowiol and coverslip if using a chamber slide.
Examine slide/plate under a fluorescence microscope.
Prepare a collagen IV-coated 24-well plate as described in step 7, except use a volume of 300 μl of coating solution per well of 24-well plate.
Aspirate hECSR medium from 6-well plate containing EECM-BMEC-like cells.
Add 1 mL of Accutase per well of the 6-well plate.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 in the incubator until EECM-BMEC-like cells detach (approximately 7 min).
Collect EECM-BMEC-like cells in a 15 mL centrifuge tube containing 4 mL of hESFM or DMEM/F-12-10 per 1 mL of Accutase.
Resuspend EECM-BMEC-like cells suspension well and collect 10 μL of cell suspension for counting.
Centrifuge EECM-BMEC-like cells at 200 g, 5 min, at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend at 9.5 × 10^4 EECM-BMEC-like cells per ml of hECSR medium.
Aspirate the collagen IV coating solution.
Add 1 mL of EECM-BMEC-like cells suspension to each well of the collagen IV-coated 24-well plate (9.5 × 10^4/well).
Transfer 24-well chamber slide or 96-well plate into the incubator (37°C, 5% CO2).
Gently move the plate back and forth and from side to side on the incubator shelf to evenly distribute the cells.
Avoid circular motions to prevent cells from pooling in the center of the well.
Change hECSR medium to CM derived from SMLCs in the presence or absence of 1 ng/mL TNF-α + 20 IU/mL IFN-γ for 16–24 hours.
Aspirate CM from 24-well plate containing EECM-BMEC-like cells after cytokine stimulation.
Add 200 μL of Accutase per well to the 24-well plate.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 in the incubator until EECM-BMEC-like cells detach (approximately 7 minutes).
Collect EECM-BMEC-like cells in 15 mL centrifuge tubes containing 4 mL of hESFM or DMEM/F-12.
Resuspend EECM-BMEC-like cell suspension well and collect 10 μL of cell suspension for counting.
Centrifuge EECM-BMEC-like cells at 200 g, 5 minutes, at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend at 1 × 10^6 EECM-BMEC-like cells per ml of FACS buffer.
Add 100 μL of EECM-BMEC-like cell suspension to each well of a 96-well plate (round bottom) (1 × 10^5/well).
Centrifuge EECM-BMEC-like cells in the 96-well round bottom plate at 330 g, 3 minutes, at 4°C.
Maintain EECM-BMEC-like cells at 4°C to avoid antibody internalization.
Prepare adhesion molecule antibody staining mixture in FACS buffer.
Prepare isotype control antibody mixture solutions in FACS buffer.
Discard buffer by inverting the 96-well plate with a quick forceful shake.
Resuspend EECM-BMEC-like cells in 100 μL of prepared antibody solutions or FACS buffer for unstained control.
Stain EECM-BMEC-like cells with fluorescent labeled antibodies at 4°C for 20 minutes.
Prepare compensation beads by adding 1 drop of positive and negative beads into 2 mL of FACS buffer.
Aliquot compensation bead suspensions into 7 separate flow tubes.
Add respective volume of each fluorophore-conjugated antibody to the aliquoted compensation bead suspensions.
Store compensation bead mixtures at 4°C protected from light until measurement.
Incubate EECM-BMEC-like cells with antibodies for 20 minutes.
Centrifuge EECM-BMEC-like cells at 330 g, 3 min, at 4°C.
Discard buffer containing antibodies by inverting the 96-well plate in one continuous motion.
Add 200 μl of FACS buffer and resuspend EECM-BMEC-like cells for washing.
Centrifuge EECM-BMEC-like cells at 330 g, 3 min, at 4°C.
Discard buffer by inverting the 96-well plate in one continuous motion.
Resuspend EECM-BMEC-like cells in 200 μL of FACS buffer.
Analyze the resuspended cells on a flow cytometer.
Use the Attune NxT Flow Cytometer for analysis.
Set the following parameters: FSC voltage at 50, SSC voltage at 280, BL1 filter voltage at 300 for FITC detection.
Configure RL1 filter voltage at 360 for APC detection.
Adjust RL3 filter voltage at 340 for APC-Cy7 detection.
Set VL1 filter voltage at 220 for BV421 detection.
Calibrate VL2 filter voltage at 240 for BV510 detection.
Configure YL1 filter voltage at 320 for PE detection.
Adjust YL4 filter voltage at 340 for PE-Cy7 detection.
Prepare EECM-BMEC-like cell monolayers as described in section 14 steps “a–i”.
Thaw 1 vial (8 × 10^6 cells) of cryopreserved T cells by rapidly rubbing the tube between your hands or swirling in a 37°C water bath until there is only a small piece of ice remaining.
Drop the cell suspension into the 15 ml centrifuge tube containing 10 ml T-cell wash buffer using a micropipette.
Transfer thawed T cells immediately into a tube containing T-cell wash buffer upon signs of thawing.
Centrifuge T cells at 280 g, 5 min, at 20°C–25°C.
Label a 24-well plate with the name of the T cell and date.
Remove supernatant from pelleted T cells.
Resuspend T cell pellet in 2 ml of T-cell medium.
Seed T cell suspension into two wells of a 24-well plate.
Incubate the 24-well plate at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Label T cells with 1 μM CMFDA at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 30 min on day of experiment.
Collect T cells into a 15 ml centrifuge tube after labeling.
Fill the tube to 12 ml with T-cell wash buffer.
Centrifuge T cells at 280 g, 5 min, at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate supernatant from pelleted T cells.
Resuspend T cells in 6 ml of T-cell wash buffer.
Add 3 ml of Ficoll-Paque PLUS below the T cell suspension.
Centrifuge at 770 g, 20 min at 20°C–25°C with minimal brake and acceleration.
Collect live T cells from the interphase between T-cell wash buffer and Ficoll-Paque PLUS.
Resuspend collected T cells in 12 ml of T-cell wash buffer.
Centrifuge T cells at 280 g, 5 min, at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend T cells in 5 mL of migration assay medium.
Resuspend T cell suspension well and take 10 μL of cell suspension for counting.
Centrifuge T cells at 280 g, 5 min, at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend T cells at 2 × 10^5 T cells per ml of migration assay medium.
Carefully remove CM from chamber slide containing EECM-BMEC-like cells.
Add 100 μL of T cell suspension (2.0 × 10^4 cells/well) to the chamber slide.
Incubate EECM-BMEC-like cells with T cells on an orbital shaker platform for 30 min at 20°C–25°C with protection from light.
After 30 min of T cell-EECM-BMEC-like cell interaction, remove plastic chambers from the glass slide.
Wash the slide containing T cell and EECM-BMEC-like cells twice by gently dipping the slide into a jar with dPBS to remove non-adherent T cells.
Fix adherent T cell and EECM-BMEC-like cells with 2.5% (v/v) glutaraldehyde solution diluted in dPBS at 4°C for 2 h.
Use glutaraldehyde solution to fix cells after the adhesion assay.
Wash slides containing adherent T cells and EECM-BMEC-like cells twice by dipping into a jar with dPBS.
Examine the slide using a fluorescence microscope with a 10 × objective.
Acquire images from the center of the well.
Analyze images with FIJI software (Version 2.0.0, Image J, USA).
